comparison.within_domain: Identical source, candidate contract, construction and evaluation cases, compiler and budget; identical generated Go digest in each observed pair.
comparison.across_domains: Shared report and renderer source bytes; different input IDs, fields, conditions, alternatives and expected behavior.
comparison.model_top_choice: Assembly proposed mask 7 satisfied 3/3 construction cases; documentation proposed mask 7 satisfied 2/3 cases (8/9 fields), then mask 5 satisfied 3/3 (9/9).
comparison.timing_scope: One sequential pair per domain, deterministic first, shared host and uncontrolled caches. No comparative speed conclusion or host CPU utilization estimate.

limits: Two caller-input policy tools; repository observation adapters are not part of this experiment.
Seven disjoint root inputs per domain and fourteen named activity outputs per run are finite observations.
This uses the supported record/body profile. Arbitrary ontology modules, general domain portability and behavioral equivalence outside the declared cases remain unproven.
The model ranks three binary field updates. It does not write arbitrary bodies or alter the type rules.
A high model probability is not calibrated task correctness; the documentation proposal scored 0.99983287 but missed one required field.
reproduction: See examples/domain-tools/README.md. Use the compiler revision recorded here and the pinned model artifact; omit --assembly-model for deterministic ordering.
